title: Ravenous

inlines.v: RAV'ENOUS, adjective 1. Furiously voracious; hungry even to rage; devouring with rapacious eagerness; as a ravenous wolf, lion or vulture. 2. Eager for prey or gratification; as ravenous appetite or desire.
